summary.text: LaShae Sharp-Collins, a Democrat, represents the 79th Assembly District, which covers part of San Diego County, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she was elected in November 2024 and, before that, served as Community Engagement Specialist for the San Diego County Office of Education.

According to the same page, she attended Lincoln High School and San Diego State University, where she earned a bachelor's degree in Africana Studies, a master's in Education and an Ed.D. in Educational Leadership, and later returned as an adjunct professor.
